name: bld2_pisano_fib_dvd_four_mul
informal: Uses Mathlib2.p3_aux_period (and the argument of Mathlib2.p3_prop2): p3_aux_period with index 2n gives fib (i + 4n) ≡ fib i mod fib (2n), and fib n ∣ fib (2n), so 4n is a period modulo fib n; the least period divides every period (division with remainder), as in p3_prop2.
